title: Senior Demand Generation Specialist, Hotels (12M FTC)
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Airbnb Hotels organization is a fun, entrepreneurial, start-up team where you can have outsized impact. Simplicity is at the core of our products. We pride ourselves on delivering the smoothest and most intuitive hotel booking experience. For hotels, we make it easy to drive incremental bookings so they can focus on the craft of hosting. We aspire to facilitate hotel discovery and serendipity at scale, benefitting guests and hotel partners.

The Difference You will Make:

Airbnb is building the world's largest supply of boutique and independent hotels on its platform. To accelerate that growth, we're hiring a Senior Demand Generation Specialist to own the inbound engine for our Hotels Acquisition team.

This is a high-impact, strategic and hands-on role sitting at the intersection of marketing and sales. This is Airbnb's first-ever B2B demand generation role. You'll build the Hotels inbound motion from the ground up across EMEA, as a 12-month pilot that will shape how we scale it globally.

A Typical Day:

  • Define and own the EMEA inbound strategy and roadmap, prioritising the channels and initiatives that will drive the most hotel go-lives
  • Build and scale multi-channel inbound programs (email, paid, SEO, content, events, partnerships) targeting independent hotels, boutique chains, and hotel groups globally
  • Own the full funnel from lead capture to MQL handoff, including lead scoring, routing, and CRM hygiene in Salesforce, in collaboration with RevOps Teams
  • Design Linkedin campaigns in coordination with regional AE teams to target high-priority segments and geographies
  • Develop outbound-assist sequences (via tools like Mixmax or Outreach) to complement AE prospecting
  • Partner with Global Marketing to build collateral, landing pages, and nurture flows that speak to hotel operator pain points
  • Track, report, and optimize against pipeline contribution metrics: MQLs, MQL-to-SQL conversion, cost per lead, and influenced revenue
  • Run co-marketing and referral programs with industry partners (channel managers, PMSes, hospitality associations)
  • Build business cases for each campaign, secure budget from stakeholders, and show clear ROI
  • Run a test-and-learn approach: launch quickly, measure, cut what doesn't work and scale what does
  • Use AI and automation to scale campaign creation, content and lead nurture
  • Work with Connectivity, Events, Country Managers and AEs to turn webinars, events and partnerships into measurable pipeline

Your Expertise:

  • 8+ years of experience in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, ideally within marketplace, hospitality tech, or SaaS environments
  • Proven track record of building inbound programs that generate measurable sales pipeline, including experience building a demand gen function from scratch (startup, scale-up, or new-business environment)
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce, marketing automation tools (MixMax, Outreach, or similar), and paid channels
  • Strong analytical, systems-driven approach; comfortable running campaigns yourself, not just briefing others
  • Data-driven: you own your funnel metrics and can connect campaign activity to revenue impact
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate campaigns and create content at scale
  • Strong sales alignment instincts; you treat AEs as internal customers
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to shape your own scope, make the case for investment, and adjust quickly based on results
  • Fluent in written and spoken English; additional European languages a plus
  • Experience operating globally across multiple regions/languages a plus

Why This Role:

Airbnb Hotels is one of the company's highest-priority supply growth initiatives. This role sits at the center of that effort, with direct visibility to senior leadership and the ability to shape how the world's most recognized travel brand expands into professional hospitality.

As the first person in this role, you'll help show what B2B demand generation can do for Airbnb Hotels. While this is a 12-month fixed-term contract, a successful pilot could lead to the role continuing beyond the initial term.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

France Annual Pay Range
€74.000—€92.000 EUR

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Growth Lead, SEA
description:
About the Team

The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments worldwide. We work across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention and monetization, through product experiments, in-product improvements, performance marketing, creative development, and AI-powered workflows.

The International Growth team works with regional leaders in priority markets to identify the user needs and product gaps that matter most for adoption, usage, and monetization. We turn country priorities into product roadmaps and growth plans, then partner with engineering, research, design, data science, marketing, finance, policy, and partnerships to test and ship improvements.

We combine product strategy with hands-on growth operations. We account for local behavior, competition, and product experience while building shared capabilities such as segmentation, lifecycle journeys, and experimentation systems. We measure what ships, adapt it to the market, and scale approaches that work across markets.

About the Role

We’re looking for a growth lead in Singapore to shape and execute ChatGPT’s growth plans. You’ll partner with the Singapore GM to understand local users, identify the biggest growth opportunities, and turn those priorities into product improvements, funnel optimizations, and performance marketing tests. You’ll work across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, collaborating with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Partnerships, and Marketing teams to influence priorities and ship measurable impact. The role combines product growth and funnel optimization with performance marketing: connecting audience, message, creative, and channel learnings to better in-product journeys.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with the regional GM to set a country growth plan and roadmap priorities, with clear hypotheses, owners, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.

  • Use user research, funnel and cohort data, and competitive insight to find local friction and prioritize the opportunities that matter most to users.

  • Run performance marketing tests in collaboration with regional marketers across relevant channels, creators, and partners; use incrementality, CAC, payback, and LTV to decide what to scale.

  • Design and run rigorous experiments across onboarding, activation, repeat usage, re-engagement, and paid conversion; measure incremental impact and iterate. Work with Product, Engineering, Design, and Data Science partners to prototype, test, and ship locally relevant experiences.

  • Partner with regional Marketing and central media teams to brief and prioritize audience, positioning, creative, and channel tests based on the country plan.

  • Own the country growth scorecard across acquisition, retention, paid conversion, and unit economics, distinguishing incremental user and revenue gains and learnings Connect priority use cases, product improvements, and acquisition plans into a coherent journey from first exposure to repeated value.

  • Run the growth operating cadence with the GM and regional teams, aligning central and local partners on results, trade-offs, dependencies, and next steps.

  • Build and operate segmentation, lifecycle journeys, growth tooling, performance marketing and product experimentation capabilities that can be scaled across markets.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience across product growth, growth marketing, data science, or growth strategy and operations, with hands-on execution in a fast-moving technology company.

  • A user-first track record of turning local research and behavior into product and growth priorities, then shipping improvements with measurable impact.

  • Strong command of acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization funnels, including technically rigorous experimentation and interpretation.

  • Practical performance marketing experience across audience, channel, creative, and measurement decisions, and the ability to partner effectively with media specialists.

  • Analytical fluency in cohort analysis and growth economics, including incrementality, LTV, CAC, payback, and contribution margin.

  • Experience adapting and running campaigns across markets, using local audience behavior, channels, language, and cultural context to improve relevance and performance at scale.

  • Experience owning growth goals and delivering measurable user or revenue outcomes across product and marketing levers.

  • The ability to influence and align central and regional teams, translate local needs into scalable approaches, and make progress through ambiguity.

Workplace & Location

  • Singapore

  • Travel as needed for key cross-functional sprints and regional collaboration.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

title: Senior Community Growth Manager
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Chief Business Officer organization plays a pivotal role in driving the company’s growth and expansion efforts worldwide. Our teammates work on commercializing Airbnb’s new and existing businesses, helping Airbnb expand beyond its core offering as a place to stay. This includes recruiting and developing Airbnb’s global supply of high-quality stays, Experiences, and services, and executing Airbnb’s global in market strategy. With this focus on business strategy, quality supply and international expansion, the team is leading the way for Airbnb’s continued growth and facilitation of millions more host and guest connections.

The difference you will make:

The Airbnb Brazil team is looking for a Senior Community Growth Manager to launch and manage host growth programs in Brazil. These programs include the Co-Host Network, Superhost Ambassadors, and other programs in incubation. In this role, you will be part of the Community Powered Growth team within our Business organization. This team’s objective is to drive growth of Airbnb’s host population and leverage new product offerings to create additional opportunities for existing hosts. This role comes with hybrid program operations and scaled relationship management responsibilities. This role carries revenue and business performance goals.

You will be responsible for designing playbooks, while adapting central frameworks to capture local market dynamics that will shape future iterations of our community programs. You will partner with our central commercial teams, community teams, sales operations and other cross functional partners to pilot new projects, tactics and/or initiatives that can be scaled into broader cross-functional programs.

You will analyze program performance and insights to craft strategic plans to ensure the needs of our hosts, co-hosts, and the Airbnb business are supported. Your success in this role will be based on a variety of metrics that reflect your impact to the business. This includes the level of growth, retention, and success of the hosting business in Brazil.

The ideal candidate is a strategic operator, analytical, strong content development skills, and adept at business planning for the long term while remaining nimble and adaptive to short term priorities. This includes relationship building and management within our host community.

A typical day:

Program Launches:

  • Supporting recruitment and onboarding education for new co-hosts, Ambassadors, and other hosts in these programs
  • Analyzing regional and territory business trends and outcomes to identify and scale growth opportunities
  • Designing, piloting, and testing new levers that support host growth at scale
  • Developing and maintaining a community forum to increase reach and feedback loops for program, product support and community support
  • Execution of workshops, events, webinars, partnerships and other channels to build an integrated strategy
  • Adapting central programs to support regional objectives

Community Management:

  • Design and operationalize effective email and scaled communication campaigns to support lifecycle engagement and education
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for hosts in the Community Powered Growth programs. Advising and supporting them as they build their property management businesses
  • Building sentiment and feedback channels to size and package insights for product and central programs
  • Identify and pilot opportunities to increase overall host success

Business Strategy:

  • You will be responsible for revenue and host growth goals
  • You will develop new programs and initiatives
  • You will implement plans and evaluate overall efficacy to inform business initiatives
  • You will lead through inspiration, influence, and our core value of belonging

Outcomes and Impact:

  • You will contribute meaningfully to a strategic outcome for Airbnb to unlock the next generation of hosts
  • You will pioneer a new growth model and structure for Airbnb. This includes developing project plans, collaborating with cross-functional teams around the world, partnering with multiple stakeholders, and crafting mitigation plans to solution design
  • You will support the development, execution and scale of pilots to accelerate evolving business verticals
  • Act as a change agent and effectively utilize change management methodologies when deploying solutions and processes.
  • Lead resource development for the community with engaging and high impact communications
  • Develop deep knowledge of your assigned geographic markets and become the go-to source relating to local, trends and market dynamics for internal and external partners
  • Support online and offline community events (webinars, meetups, and workshops)

Your expertise:

  • 8+ years experience in Sales, Business Operations, or Business Development in Tech, Real Estate/Property Management, or Travel
  • You are strategic in your thinking; proven ability to drive growth and to own growth OKRs while exceeding goals.
  • You think and act like an entrepreneur. You are resourceful and goal driven.
  • Strong project management skills and demonstrated experience leading strategic programs and processes.
  • Can forecast, model, and optimize growth tactics based on known and unknown performance
  • You have sales or external relationship management experience across tech and consumer goods
  • Ability to influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus building
  • Ability to assess a problem, opportunity or business challenges quickly and make decisions based on the facts presented, creative problem solving, and previous experience.
  • Excellent communication (written & verbal) and interpersonal skills with strong business acumen that will enable you to earn trust at all levels
  • Strong empathy for our community AND passion for revenue and growth
  • Deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models
  • Enthusiastic and creative leader with the ability to inspire others
  • Ability to flourish with minimal guidance, be proactive, and handle uncertainty and ambiguity
  • Expert with Excel (pivot tables, large data set analyses, and formulas), analytical tools (SQL), and methodologies like capacity planning, forecasting, general modeling for prioritization and decision making
  • Comfortable with Google Docs, Salesforce CRM, and other technology solutions for driving supply acquisition, territory management and retention.
  • Deep knowledge and experience using collaborative project management tools and processes (e.g. Asana, Airtable, and etc.).
  • Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish, spoken and written is required.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

title: Social Media Manager, Brand
region: Menlo Park, CA / New York, NY
salary: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC): $128,000 – $150,000 USD · Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL): $112,000 – $132,000 USD · Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL): $99,000 – $117,000 USD
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

We are looking for a Social Media Manager, Brand to drive brand storytelling, social-first creative, and culture-defining activations across our key platforms. This is a role for an experienced social/brand professional who can translate Robinhood's mission into content and moments that resonate with Millennial and Gen Z audiences. You will balance a bold, culturally fluent brand voice with the rigorous compliance standards required in financial services. This role owns brand storytelling, social activations, and creative strategy — it does not include day-to-day community moderation or customer support, which are owned by dedicated teams. This role is equal parts brand storyteller, trend-spotter, creative strategist, and cultural translator. You’ll know how to turn a product moment into a scroll-stopping activation that Millennial and Gen Z audiences share, remix, and talk about.

This role is based in our New York, NY, and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Own our social content strategy: Define the voice, tone, and creative point of view for Robinhood’s brand across X, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Reddit — ensuring every post feels distinctly Robinhood and resonates with a Millennial and Gen Z audience.
  • Lead social-first brand campaigns: Partner with Brand, Creative, and Product to conceive and execute social-native campaigns and always-on content that make Robinhood’s mission tangible and culturally relevant.
  • Spearhead social activations: Ideate and execute high-impact brand activations — cultural moments, platform-native stunts, creator collabs, live events, and surprise-and-delight drops — designed to build buzz and deepen affinity with Millennial and Gen Z audiences.
  • Speak fluently to Millennial and Gen Z audiences: Bring a deep, authentic understanding of Millennial and Gen Z culture, humor, platform behavior, and finance-adjacent trends (FinTok, FinTwit, money influencers) to keep Robinhood’s content native and credible.
  • Stay ahead of culture: Constantly track platform algorithm shifts, emerging formats, meme culture, and rising creators to keep Robinhood’s brand presence cutting-edge, timely, and relevant.

title: Growth Lead, France
description:

The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments worldwide. We work across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention and monetization, through product experiments, in-product improvements, performance marketing, creative development, and AI-powered workflows.

The International Growth team works with regional leaders in priority markets to identify the user needs and product gaps that matter most for adoption, usage, and monetization. We turn country priorities into product roadmaps and growth plans, then partner with engineering, research, design, data science, marketing, finance, policy, and partnerships to test and ship improvements.

We combine product strategy with hands-on growth operations. We account for local behavior, competition, and product experience while building shared capabilities such as segmentation, lifecycle journeys, and experimentation systems. We measure what ships, adapt it to the market, and scale approaches that work across markets.

About the Role

We’re looking for a growth lead in France to shape and execute ChatGPT’s growth plans. You’ll partner with the France GM to understand local users, identify the biggest growth opportunities, and turn those priorities into product improvements, funnel optimizations, and performance marketing tests. You’ll work across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, collaborating with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Partnerships, and Marketing teams to influence priorities and ship measurable impact. The role combines product growth and funnel optimization with performance marketing: connecting audience, message, creative, and channel learnings to better in-product journeys.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with the France GM, regional teams, and central teams to set a country growth plan and roadmap priorities, with clear hypotheses, owners, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.

  • Use user research, funnel and cohort data, and competitive insight to find local friction and prioritize the opportunities that matter most to users.

  • Run performance marketing tests in collaboration with regional marketers across relevant channels, creators, and partners; use incrementally, CAC, payback, and LTV to decide what to scale.

  • Design and run rigorous experiments across onboarding, activation, repeat usage, re-engagement, and paid conversion; measure incremental impact and iterate. Work with Product, Engineering, Design, and Data Science partners to prototype, test, and ship locally relevant experiences.

  • Partner with regional Marketing and central media teams to brief and prioritize audience, positioning, creative, and channel tests based on the country plan.

  • Own the country growth scorecard across acquisition, retention, paid conversion, and unit economics, distinguishing incremental user and revenue gains and learnings

  • Connect priority use cases, product improvements, and acquisition plans into a coherent journey from first exposure to repeated value.

  • Run the growth operating cadence with the GM and regional teams, aligning central and local partners on results, trade-offs, dependencies, and next steps.

  • Build and operate product experimentation capabilities, segmentation, lifecycle/user journeys, performance marketing, and growth platform/tooling that can be scaled across markets.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience across product growth, data science, or growth strategy and operations, with hands-on execution in a fast-moving technology company.

  • A user-first track record of turning local research and behavior into product and growth priorities, then shipping improvements with measurable impact.

  • Strong command of acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization funnels, including technically rigorous experimentation and interpretation.

  • Practical performance marketing experience across audience, channel, creative, and measurement decisions, and the ability to partner effectively with media specialists.

  • Analytical fluency in cohort analysis and growth economics, including incrementality, LTV, CAC, payback, and contribution margin.

  • Experience adapting and running campaigns across markets, using local audience behavior, channels, language, and cultural context to improve relevance and performance at scale.

  • Experience owning growth goals and delivering measurable user or revenue outcomes across product and marketing levers.

title: Designer, Growth Marketing
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across the US — we also have offices in New York, San Francisco, Seattle, London, Paris, and Tel Aviv.

We're looking for a Designer, Growth (Product Marketing) to sit at the intersection of brand, performance marketing, and generative media. This is not a brand systems or campaign concepting role — it's a high-volume, output-driven design role. You'll own the visual execution of paid and performance marketing across video, motion, and static formats, producing assets that are on-brand, well art directed and built to convert. You'll report to the Creative Director of Product Marketing.

Your work will directly shape how people first encounter and engage with Runway's products. That means producing scroll-stopping video ads, designing static and animated assets for paid social and display, and using generative tools — including Runway's own — as a core part of how you work. You'll partner closely with product marketing, growth, and creative teams, and you'll be measured on craft, throughput, and performance.

What you'll do

  • Design and produce high volumes of performance marketing assets across video, motion, and static formats — paid social, display, YouTube and beyond

  • Use Runway to ideate, create and iterate on video and image assets that are on-brand and well art directed — not just technically functional

  • Own the visual execution of ad creative from concept through final delivery, working from briefs or generating your own directions when needed

  • Produce motion graphics and animated ads that communicate product value quickly and compellingly

  • Partner with the Product Marketing and growth team to develop integrated ad concepts where copy and design work together

  • Build and iterate on creative variants for A/B and multivariate testing — adapting formats, hooks and visual treatments based on performance data

  • Maintain a consistent visual language across all performance touchpoints without letting assets feel templated or stale

  • Collaborate with product marketing on go-to-market launches, translating new product capabilities into visual stories that resonate with target audiences

  • Hands-on experience designing for the major paid channels (Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, etc) with fluency in each platform's native specs, aspect ratios and ad formats, and a real point of view on what works where.

  • Own updates to GTM assets and templates, keeping them current and on-brand across campaigns. Bring hands-on experience building and automating deck design systems, so our presentations stay consistent without manual rework each time.

  • Contribute to a growing library of on-brand design components, motion templates and generative prompting strategies that raise the team's overall output velocity

What you'll need

  • 3-5 years of experience in performance marketing design, motion design, or a related role at a tech or consumer company

  • A portfolio that shows range across video ads, motion graphics and static performance creative — with clear evidence of craft and art direction judgment, not just execution

  • Strong motion design skills — you're fluent in After Effects, Premiere, or equivalent, and can produce polished animated and video assets independently

  • Solid graphic design fundamentals — typography, layout, color — applied to high-converting ad formats, not just editorial or brand work

  • Hands-on experience using AI image and video generation tools with an art director's eye — you know how to prompt, iterate and finish work that looks intentional

  • Comfort with performance data — you can look at creative metrics and know what visual changes to make next

  • Ability to operate at high velocity across multiple simultaneous campaigns without sacrificing quality

  • Experience working closely with growth marketers and product teams in a fast-moving environment

  • Experience in AI, creative tools or developer-adjacent products is a strong plus

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.
